$comment: Negotiation-time trust payload (decoded) - The consumer's PNP retrieves its public information from the PIP with no policy and hands the result to the trust component as the credential subject of a signed verifiable credential. The provider verifies the token on the contract request and the PAP stores the verified credential subject as trustData.subject on the finalised agreement.

informationSourceConfiguration.$comment: The static information source entry on the consumer node that produced the credential subject. Only entries with a public or any access mode and no matchLocators answer the policy-less retrieve at negotiation start.
